value_or_source: adapters trimmed; applied to both tumour and normal FASTQ
why_required: Adapter read-through and 3' low-quality tails are removed before alignment
consequence_if_omitted: Adapter sequence aligns as soft-clipped or mismatched bases and produces false SNV/indel candidates near fragment ends; tails with Q<20 inflate low-BQ alt reads

value_or_source: reference ref/hg19.fa; separate read group per sample
why_required: Read group SM tag is how the caller tells tumour from normal
consequence_if_omitted: Both BAMs carry the same sample name and the caller cannot separate them, so the normal is treated as tumour reads and somatic evidence is lost

argument: samtools sort -o T.sorted.bam && samtools index T.sorted.bam
why_required: Region-restricted calling (-L) needs random access
consequence_if_omitted: Mutect2 fails with a missing-index / unsorted-input error and no calls are produced

value_or_source: duplicate flag set (no UMIs in this assay: sample_meta.json)
why_required: Hybrid-capture without UMIs yields PCR duplicates of one molecule
consequence_if_omitted: Duplicates are counted as independent reads: alt_count and depth are inflated and a single PCR error looks like multi-read support, passing min_alt (>=5 reads)

argument: gatk BaseRecalibrator -I T.md.bam -R ref/hg19.fa --known-sites known/dbsnp.vcf.gz --known-sites known/Mills_indels.vcf.gz -O T.recal.table; gatk ApplyBQSR
why_required: mean_alt_bq (filter 11) is only meaningful with calibrated qualities
consequence_if_omitted: Systematic machine-cycle quality bias is not corrected, so BQ<20 filter removes the wrong sites and miscalled low-quality bases reach the callset

argument: gatk Mutect2 -R ref/hg19.fa -I T.recal.bam -I N.recal.bam -normal TGB-SOM-014-N -L target_intervals.bed
why_required: Restricts calling to the capture territory and names the matched normal
consequence_if_omitted: Without -normal the normal is treated as a second tumour and normal alt evidence cannot reject germline; without -L off-target sites (filter 1) are called and TMB denominator is wrong

why_required: Supplies population AF used to weigh germline vs somatic
consequence_if_omitted: Germline variants with normal coverage gaps are called somatic; at multiallelic loci the AF of a different alt is used (e.g. chr17:7577538 G>A matched to the G>C row)

why_required: Prior for alleles absent from the resource
consequence_if_omitted: Default (0.001 tumour-only / resource-dependent) is applied: wrong germline prior and wrong expected_contam_alt for 41 of 48 sites

why_required: Recurrent technical artifacts seen in unrelated normals
consequence_if_omitted: Systematic sequencing/mapping artifacts (e.g. chr7:5300122, chr12:8411980) remain PASS with clean-looking VAF 0.15

why_required: Needed to learn the read-orientation artifact model
consequence_if_omitted: LearnReadOrientationModel has no input, so C>A / G>T oxidation (OxoG/FFPE) artifacts are not modeled

why_required: Matches filter 11 and reduces indel error in repeats
consequence_if_omitted: Low-quality bases enter active regions; indel errors in homopolymer runs are over-called as real insertions/deletions

why_required: Strand-asymmetric (C>A/G>T) artifacts are distinguished from real mutations
consequence_if_omitted: Orientation-biased candidates such as chr12:8500771 (39 fwd / 1 rev) pass as genuine

argument: gatk GetPileupSummaries -I T.recal.bam -V common_biallelic.vcf.gz -L common_biallelic.vcf.gz -O T.pileups.table; same for N
why_required: Estimates cross-sample contamination from allele fractions
consequence_if_omitted: contamination_fraction is unknown; expected_contam_alt cannot be computed and filter 7 cannot run

argument: gatk CalculateContamination T.pileups.table -matched N.pileups.table -tumor-segmentation segments.table -O contamination.table
why_required: Gives the fraction and the allele-fraction segmentation
consequence_if_omitted: Contaminating-sample alleles appear as low-VAF 'somatic' variants; without -matched, germline het SNPs in the tumour are misread as contamination

why_required: Composite key keeps alt alleles at the same position separate
consequence_if_omitted: Joining on chrom+pos only merges chr7:5350700 C>T with C>G: wrong normal_vaf, one site mis-filtered as germline

argument: vaf = alt_count/depth; normal_vaf = normal_alt/normal_depth; strand_balance = min(alt_fwd,alt_rev)/alt_count
why_required: Inputs to filters 3,4,6,8,9
consequence_if_omitted: Using ref_count or total reads as denominator shifts vaf off the 0.02 and 0.20 cut points

argument: expected_contam_alt = contamination_fraction x tumour depth x af_used
why_required: Compares observed alt reads with what contamination alone predicts
consequence_if_omitted: Common germline alleles in a contaminant are called as somatic at VAF ~ contamination_fraction x AF

argument: FilterMutectCalls -V unfiltered.vcf.gz -R ref/hg19.fa --contamination-table contamination.table --tumor-segmentation segments.table --ob-priors read-orientation-model.tar.gz
why_required: Final GATK probabilistic filtration step
consequence_if_omitted: Raw Mutect2 output is not a callset: all artifact classes (contamination, orientation, strand) remain in the VCF as unfiltered

why_required: Removes variants below the validated detection limit
consequence_if_omitted: Sites at vaf 0.0167 (chr3:2612233) are reported as calls with no orthogonal support

why_required: Removes variants carried by poorly mapped reads
consequence_if_omitted: Mapping artifacts from paralogous regions (chr12:8600033 MQ 24) pass

why_required: Removes variants carried by low-quality bases
consequence_if_omitted: Sequencing errors (chr7:5500900 BQ 17) are reported as somatic SNVs

why_required: Alt bases only at read ends indicate alignment/trim artifacts
consequence_if_omitted: Read-end artifacts (chr3:2750500, median position 6) pass

argument: min_depth gate: tumour depth >= 50 and normal depth >= 20
why_required: Low normal depth cannot exclude germline or artifact
consequence_if_omitted: Germline hets with 18 normal reads look normal-negative and are called somatic (chr1:1061877)

why_required: Minimum read support
consequence_if_omitted: Single-digit alt reads with 4 supporting reads (chr1:1099004) are called

why_required: Separates inherited variants and normal-borne artifacts from somatic
consequence_if_omitted: Inherited variants (chr3:2655410, chr7:5120055) are reported as somatic; with an adjacent-tissue normal these gates also remove real somatic variants

argument: short tandem repeat gate: indel and in_tandem_repeat=yes and repeat_unit_length<=2 and repeat_n_units>=6
why_required: Polymerase slippage in short repeats creates indel artifacts
consequence_if_omitted: Slippage indels (chr1:1300044 AT>A, chr12:8650200 C>CGT) pass; applying it to SNVs would wrongly remove chr1:1300050

argument: strand gate: orientation (C>A,G>T) strand_balance<0.20; strand_bias alt_count>=10 and strand_balance<0.10
why_required: One-strand support indicates library or oxidation artifacts
consequence_if_omitted: One-strand artifacts (chr1:1210885, chr7:5410228) pass

argument: bcftools view -f PASS -T target_intervals.bed filtered.vcf.gz -Oz -o somatic.pass.vcf.gz
why_required: Final callset and TMB numerator
consequence_if_omitted: Filtered sites are counted in n_pass and tmb_per_mb is inflated

why_required: TMB must be normalised to the territory that can actually be called
consequence_if_omitted: Using the 2.01 Mb BED length instead of 1.186 Mb understates TMB by 41% (11.4 vs 19.4 per Mb)
